sources.authority: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
sources.workload_condition: Only where server-side range/sort is indispensable and leakage is explicitly accepted
sources.privacy_property: Order and frequency leakage can enable plaintext recovery

sources.known_limitation: Attack outcomes depend on leakage profile and auxiliary data

sources.document: Inference Attacks on Property-Preserving Encrypted Databases
sources.workload_condition: Evaluate auxiliary-distribution attacks before preserving database properties
sources.privacy_property: Deterministic and order leakage can expose plaintext distributions
sources.known_limitation: Medical datasets were studied, not this synthetic financial dataset

sources.document: Breaking the FF3 Format-Preserving Encryption Standard over Small Domains
sources.workload_condition: Reject weak-domain FPE and obsolete FF3
sources.utility_property: Format preservation alone provides no workload utility guarantee

sources.document: Global Measures of Data Utility for Microdata Masked for Disclosure Limitation
sources.workload_condition: Measure utility for the actual analysis rather than by a global score
sources.privacy_property: Disclosure limitation and utility are distinct
sources.utility_property: Workload-specific analyses can diverge from global utility
sources.known_limitation: Statistical microdata differs from operational customer support

sources.document: Evaluating the Risk of Disclosure and Utility in a Synthetic Dataset

sources.utility_property: Risk and utility must both be evaluated
sources.known_limitation: Different mechanism and no record-level support use case
